args.reason: The DoD covers only a `--dry-run` flag that runs the existing merge-floor reads and prints the decision without calling `gh pr merge`. That serves the first PRD goal (inspect merge eligibility without risking a merge) and nothing beyond it. It reuses the existing floor logic rather than adding a second eligibility path, so the second goal (one source of truth) is respected. No history or query capability is added, so nothing falls outside the PRD.
